title: Managed machine principals onboarding, owner attestation, and template registry
creator: Ava Patel
description: Problem statement: Our current service account model has grown organically and creates operational risk: inconsistent privilege assignments, unclear ownership, manual onboarding steps, and limited visibility in audit logs. This ticket defines a managed 'machine principal' onboarding flow plus a registry of canonical permission templates that map to RBAC v2 roles and SSO/SAML provisioning. Goals: 1) make creation of machine principals self-service but gated by attestation/approval for high-privilege templates, 2) ensure every principal has a recorded owner and rotation cadence, 3) provide a small but extensible set of audited least-privilege templates that are composable, 4) emit structured audit events for creation/attestation/rotation/deletion and surface them in Console and SIEM integration, 5) provide migration utilities for legacy service accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Console: new 'Create Machine Principal' flow available under Admin > Identities with template selector and owner field

Templates: at least 8 canonical templates published in the registry (compute-readonly, logs-writer, inference-serving-minimal, infra-deploy, db-migrations, telemetry-emit, storage-readonly, monitoring-agent) and documented in Confluence
Attestation: templates that grant write/delete privileges trigger an approver flow (email + Console) before creation; approved events are stored and linked to principal metadata
Audit: create/approve/update/rotate/delete events emitted as structured JSON to our audit sink (kafka topic audit-events-v2) and show up in Console activity feed within 30s
Ownership: every created principal has an owner field; owners can delegate a backup owner; owners receive rotation reminders at configurable TTLs
RBAC compatibility: templates map cleanly to RBAC v2 roles and policy engine accepts mapped roles for enforcement
CLI/SDK: a CLI command `redwood identity create --template <name> --owner <email>` exists and follows same attestation/approval rules

Migration: provide a script to import legacy service accounts that flags missing owners and offers template recommendations; at least 80% of imported accounts must be auto-mapped to a template or flagged for manual review
Security review: security team sign-off recorded in ticket comments before GA release
